questions.passage: At the core of a psychologically rich personality are openness to experience and extraversion. One might ask, though: How can those of us who don’t have those basic personality traits become more open and extraverted? One answer is to embrace playfulness. In a 1980 study, when Robert McCrae and Paul Costa asked 240 men to complete various sentences such as, “What gets me into trouble is…” and “When his wife asked him to do the housework…,” open-minded men’s responses were far more playful than closed-minded men’s responses.
questions.prompt: Which traits are said to be at the core of a psychologically rich personality?
questions.promptZh: 心理丰富人格核心被说成是哪两项特质？
options: Conscientiousness and agreeableness.
Emotional stability and openness to experience.
Openness to experience and extraversion.
Extraversion and emotional stability.
optionsZh: 尽责性与宜人性。
情绪稳定性与经验开放性。
经验开放性与外向性。
外向性与情绪稳定性。
analyses: A 这两项在前面有次要预测作用，非此处核心两项。
B 只保留开放性，却用情绪稳定替换外向性。
C At the core...are 后直接列开放性及外向性。
D 是幸福部分着重的组合，不能替换心理丰富人格核心；本章随后仍允许缺少这些倾向者成长。

vocabulary.meaning: 在核心；最重要的中心部分
vocabulary.context: 是概念核心，不是人体器官或所有必要资源条件。

questions.translation: 心理丰富人格的核心是经验开放性与外向性。但有人或许会问：缺少这些基本特质的我们，怎样变得更开放、更外向？一种回答是拥抱玩心。1980 年的一项研究中，Robert McCrae 与 Paul Costa 请 240 名男性补全“让我惹上麻烦的是……”和“当妻子请他做家务时……”等句子；开放男性的回答比不开放男性的回答俏皮得多。

One might ask, though: How can those of us who don’t have those basic personality traits become more open and extraverted? One answer is to embrace playfulness. In a 1980 study, when Robert McCrae and Paul Costa asked 240 men to complete various sentences such as, “What gets me into trouble is…” and “When his wife asked him to do the housework…,” open-minded men’s responses were far more playful than closed-minded men’s responses.

questions.passage: For instance, a man high in openness to experience said, “When my wife asked me to do the housework, I invented an urgent excuse.” A closed-minded man would have responded, “When my wife asked me to do the housework, I reluctantly did.” McCrae and Costa observed, “The final distinguishing characteristic of open men is a playful, sometimes odd, sense of humor. A slight twist may be given to meanings, and obviously playful objections to the test are frequently made.”
questions.prompt: Which interpretation respects the contrasting housework responses?
options: They illustrate a playful twist, with the closed-minded contrast expressed conditionally.
They show that every open man actually refused all household work.
They prove that the researchers observed both men’s private homes.
They establish that reluctant housework makes all people closed-minded.
questions.promptZh: 怎样理解家务回答的对比，才保留原文强度？
optionsZh: 它们说明俏皮的转折，而不开放者的对照用条件语气表达。
说明所有开放男性实际拒绝全部家务。
证明研究者观察了两人的私人家庭。
确立勉强做家务使所有人不开放。
analyses: A invented an urgent excuse 带俏皮转折；would have responded 是条件性对照，不是所有人的实测原话。
B 句子补全回答不能直接当作实际家务行为，更不能扩大为每个人。
C 本段没有家庭观察程序。
D 没有这种确定因果方向。McCrae 与 Costa 的评论归于研究者，不必把每个比喻当字面事实。

evidence.quote: A closed-minded man would have responded
a playful, sometimes odd, sense of humor.

vocabulary.meaning: 出人意料的转折；意义上的变化

vocabulary.example: The speaker gave the familiar story an unexpected twist.

questions.translation: 例如，一位高经验开放性的男性说：“当妻子请我做家务时，我编了个紧急借口。”不开放的男性则会这样回答：“当妻子请我做家务时，我勉强做了。”这里原文对后者使用条件语气。McCrae 与 Costa 观察道：“开放男性最后一个区分性特征，是俏皮、有时古怪的幽默感。他们可能稍稍扭转意思，也常对测试提出明显带玩笑性质的异议。”

questions.passage: But what exactly is being playful? The psychoanalyst Erik Erikson described it best: when you are playful, you are “on vacation from social and economic reality.” All of us adults have a lot of social and economic responsibilities. That is the reality.
questions.prompt: Which responsibilities are explicitly acknowledged for adults?
questions.promptZh: 原文明示承认成年人有哪类责任？
options: Only financial tasks, with all social duties excluded.
Only duties within a personality questionnaire.
No responsibilities once they become playful.
Many social and economic responsibilities.
optionsZh: 只有财务任务，排除社会义务。
只有人格问卷中的义务。
一有玩心就没有责任。
许多社会及经济责任。
analyses: A social and economic 两类并列，不可漏社会。
B 问卷来自前面研究，不是全部成人义务。
C 原句肯定 have，不是否定责任。
D All of us adults...a lot of 明确主体与两类；不因此要求所有人的具体责任一模一样。

vocabulary.context: 社交与经济领域的成人责任，语境不是研究作答次数或娱乐规则。
vocabulary.example: Adults balance responsibilities with time for rest.

questions.translation: 但究竟什么叫有玩心？精神分析学家 Erik Erikson 的描述最贴切：有玩心时，你仿佛“从社会和经济现实中休假”。我们成年人都有许多社会与经济责任。这就是现实。

options: Abandoning every duty forever and becoming a full-time athlete.

与 Steph Curry 一起训练，并受雇于 Roger Ebert。

Every routine event has exactly the same stakes.

vocabulary.context: 按年龄类别的纪录，不等于所有年龄或所有世界项目绝对纪录。
vocabulary.example: She set several age group records as a junior swimmer.

questions.translation: 玩心的重要性，在得失重大的场合尤其明显，例如奥运会。Michael Phelps 在奥运个人项目中赢得十三枚金牌，广被认为是史上最优秀的游泳运动员之一。他八岁便已训练，打破各种年龄组纪录。

evidence.quote: The importance of playfulness is most noticeable during events when there is a lot at stake. For instance, the Olympics. Michael Phelps won thirteen Olympic gold medals in individual events and is widely considered one of the best swimmers of all time. He was already training at eight years old and breaking all kinds of age group records.
